review.notes: Full review. Adversarial pass over every README statement and every Suggested.lean declaration, with computed instances (27 table rows). Seeded sample of 15 targets: no locator could be checked against its text, since none of the five cited books is legally readable (two paywalled, three with no legal copy); Layer 7 statements cross-checked against a cached author's-page survey. Library declarations opened at the pins; nine cross-roadmap ids resolved on main. Targeted build succeeded; dependency check reported 0 problems. Duplication audit by object found two open roadmaps owning the same objects (PerfectAndChordalGraphs, SpectralSteepestDescent). One-tactic probe closed one declaration. One automatic form check and three citation leads set aside as false positives.
